mechanism: Both drugs can cause QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias; azithromycin may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of primaquine metabolites, and combined use increases risk of hemolytic anemia in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes; assess G6PD status before use; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; if co-administration necessary, use lowest effective doses and monitor for hemolytic symptoms.
